title: Decide whether to empty the 17 GiB Trash
notes: ~/.Trash held 5675 top-level items, 18071568 KiB (du -sk), on 2026-11-23, including agent backups moved there by the trash rule.
Mole 1.73+ empties it with rm on a manual run; ~/.Trash is now in ~/.config/mole/whitelist and update_mole refuses without it, so emptying is the owner's call (Finder, or trash-cli per volume).
done_when: The owner empties the Trash or keeps it, and the decision is recorded
